movingTips.title: 国际搬家提示
movingTips.subtitle: 顺利完成国际搬家所需了解的一切

tips.title: 尽早开始规划
tips.content: 至少在预定日期前8周开始规划搬家。这样您有时间获取更好报价并充分准备。

tips.title: 专业打包
tips.content: 使用优质打包材料。用气泡膜包裹易碎品，并用纸板或包装纸填满空隙。

tips.title: 清单与文件
tips.content: 准备详细物品清单，为贵重物品拍照以备保险，并妥善保存重要文件副本。

tips.title: 综合保险
tips.content: 投保全面货运保险。可覆盖搬家期间高价值物品的损坏或遗失。

tips.title: 了解新国家
tips.content: 了解海关规定、气候与当地文化，有助于更好地为新生活做准备。

tips.title: 清晰标注纸箱
tips.content: 在每个纸箱上写明内容与目的房间。不同房间使用不同颜色。

tips.title: 重要文件随身携带
tips.content: 护照、签证、医疗与财务文件——放在与您同行的单独包中，不要放入货运。

tips.title: 规划最初几天
tips.content: 为新居最初几天做好计划：住宿、基本食品与交通。

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: Please read these Terms carefully before using VIP International Shipping services.

sections.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
paragraphs: By accessing or using our website and services, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service.

sections.title: 2. Services
paragraphs: We provide international and domestic moving, packing, storage, and related logistics services subject to availability and applicable law.

sections.title: 3. Quotes and Pricing
paragraphs: Quotes are estimates unless expressly stated as binding. Final pricing may change after survey, inventory, access conditions, or regulatory fees.

sections.title: 4. Customer Responsibilities
paragraphs: You are responsible for accurate inventory, access to premises, required permits, and compliance with customs and prohibited-item rules.

sections.title: 5. Payments
paragraphs: Payment terms are stated on your invoice or booking confirmation. Late payments may incur fees or service delays.

sections.title: 6. Insurance and Liability
paragraphs: Coverage options are offered at booking. Liability limits apply as disclosed in your contract and applicable carrier terms.

sections.title: 7. Cancellations
paragraphs: Cancellation and rescheduling policies are provided with your booking. Deposits may be non-refundable after certain deadlines.

sections.title: 8. Privacy
paragraphs: Personal data is handled according to our Privacy Policy.

sections.title: 9. Governing Law
paragraphs: These Terms are governed by the laws of the applicable jurisdiction stated in your service agreement.

sections.title: 10. Contact
paragraphs: Questions about these Terms: support@vipshipping.com

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: How we collect, use, and protect your information
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how VIP International Shipping handles personal information.

sections.title: 1. Information we collect
paragraphs: Contact details, move addresses, shipment details, payment references, and usage data needed to provide services.

sections.title: 2. How we use information
paragraphs: To prepare quotes, operate shipments, process payments, provide support, improve services, and meet legal obligations.

sections.title: 3. Sharing
paragraphs: We share data with carriers, customs brokers, payment processors, and service providers under contract, or when required by law.

sections.title: 4. Security
paragraphs: We use administrative, technical, and physical safeguards appropriate to the sensitivity of the data.

sections.title: 5. Your rights
paragraphs: Depending on your location, you may request access, correction, deletion, or restriction of personal data.

sections.title: 6. Cookies
paragraphs: We use necessary cookies for authentication and optional analytics cookies where permitted.

sections.title: 7. International transfers
paragraphs: Data may be processed in countries where we or our partners operate, with appropriate safeguards.

sections.title: 8. Children
paragraphs: Our services are not directed to children under 16.

sections.title: 9. Changes
paragraphs: We may update this policy and will revise the last-updated date when changes are material.

sections.title: 10. Contact
paragraphs: Privacy questions: privacy@vipshipping.com
